set.body: Parent epic: bd-01KR8ZJJ8W882F1S9JWE06K741. Add scale_space_onesample(subject_images, ...) as a thin wrapper that builds stat_vol, mask, and subject-level sign-flip null_fun, then calls scale_space_energy(). It should improve on make_null_fun_subject_signflip() by pre-generating signs and using the shared image-matrix/statistic contracts. Tests: wrapper matches manual low-level call.
set.title: Scale-space: one-sample raw-image wrapper
